learning_outcomes.text: Defines the difficulties that may be encountered during the adaptation process to university life and develops coping strategies.
Defines the academic and administrative units of the university.
Can actively participate in social, cultural, and sports activities.
Can list and define student rights and responsibilities.
Understands the importance of career planning.

syllabus_topics: Information about the content and operation of the course, general information about Sakarya city.
General physical structure of the university, university administration, introduction of academic and administrative units.
Introduction of the student dean's office and student senate.
Introduction to the Student Information System, information about course selections and registration rules.
Introduction to education and training regulations.
Introduction to health services and the library.
Information about the unit for students with disabilities, campus sports/cultural areas and activities, introduction to meal scholarships, part-time work opportunities.
Introduction to student societies and events.
Introduction to Double Major (ÇAP), Minor programs, Area of Interest, Recognition of Prior Learning R&D Harmonization, Social Transcript processes.
Interpersonal communication, stress management, and combating addiction.
Career planning, sharing experiences of experts in project development.
